# Luck numbers (generated by tools/luck_sheet.py from the data)

Luck is a whole number from -10 to +10, rolled once at character creation (2 dice of 5 faces, so most people land within about 3 of zero), never trained. Strength per point is 0.04 (data/items/luck.json). Set it to 0 and luck does nothing. Tell me if +10 is too strong or too weak and I change that one number.

## Chance rolls

How a chance that is 10, 30, 50 or 90 percent for a neutral character changes:

| Luck | 10% becomes | 30% becomes | 50% becomes | 90% becomes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| -10 | 3.2% | 16.6% | 35.6% | 85.5% |
| -5 | 6.0% | 23.0% | 42.9% | 87.9% |
| +0 | 10.0% | 30.0% | 50.0% | 90.0% |
| +5 | 15.2% | 37.3% | 56.7% | 91.7% |
| +10 | 21.4% | 44.6% | 62.8% | 93.2% |

## Felled tree drops

Chances that a blow on a felled trunk also gives something (neutral value, then by luck):

| Drop | Neutral | Luck -10 | Luck +10 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bark | 30% | 16.6% | 44.6% |
| Seed or nut | 15% | 5.9% | 28.0% |
| Branch sticks (1 to 3 each) | 2.00 average | 1.76 | 2.26 |
| Roots (1 to 3 each) | 2.00 average | 1.76 | 2.26 |

## Boulders

Each blow that has another stone left gives a second stone with 5% chance for a neutral character: 1.1% at luck -10, 13.4% at +10. On a 1 m boulder (about 4,600 stones) that is a few hundred extra stones across the whole job.

## Tool wear

Luck does not touch tool wear yet; every use costs its fixed amount (TOOL_WEAR.md). If you want lucky people to wear tools slower, say so and it becomes one more fate roll.

## The counter

The server counts every fate roll by kind (`fate_counts` in server_items.gd), so we can read what luck actually touched in a play session. Today the only fate kind is the boulder bonus stone; chance and amount rolls go through the same function but are not counted by kind.
